params.caption:
🎮 CD Projekt Red just dropped a bold comparison: the leap from The Witcher 3 to The Witcher 4 will be "comparable" to Rockstar's jump from GTA 5 to GTA 6.

📣 Key facts:
• CEO Michał Nowakowski made the claim on CDPR's latest earnings call, replying to an investor question about GTA 6's record-breaking launch
• Quote: "We believe there's going to be a comparable leap between The Witcher 3 and The Witcher 4"
• CDPR says Witcher 4 development hasn't changed because of GTA 6 — still targeting 2028, no narrower date given
• Came in the same earnings call where CDPR disclosed a new Sony marketing partnership for The Witcher 4

🕐 Published: Nov 24, 2026, ~11:01 PM GMT+3

📰 Sources: Video Games Chronicle, PC Gamer
👥 x.com/CDPROJEKTRED, x.com/RockstarGames

💬 Bold claim, or fair comparison after 11 years since Witcher 3? Sound off below 👇

#TheWitcher4 #CDProjektRed #Witcher4 #GTA6 #GamingNews
